artifact: per-query search log, VENUE-AND-REGULATOR arm (source class S-D), protocol section 3.3
protocol_bytes_verified: the working-tree file digests identically to the blob at the registration commit; the protocol was not edited by this arm
executed_by: subagent (Claude Opus 5, model id claude-opus-5, Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK), dispatched by the lead session
recording_obligation: protocol section 3.0 - every query logged, including zero-yield; zero-yield queries are never dropped
query_construction_rule: protocol section 3.3, frozen: documents are located BY DOCUMENT CLASS, not by free-text topic. Each class is pursued at the arm's endpoints until it is either retrieved or recorded as absent. No free-text web search engine was used by this arm; every query is a direct request to an endpoint named in section 3.3 (the venue's own site and its rulebook/contract/fee/developer-documentation subdomains, cftc.gov including filings/orders/letters/press, the Federal Register, the eCFR, and the comparable venues' own published rule documents)
retrieval_client: curl 8.x over HTTPS, --compressed, redirect-following, browser User-Agent string; no authentication, no cookies, no API key on any request
hard_constraints_observed: NO MARKET-DATA ACQUISITION: no price, order-book, trade, candlestick or ticker endpoint was called on any venue. Kalshi's and Polymarket's own documentation pages print curl invocations that read live order books; those were read as data and NOT executed
n_returned_semantics: single-document fetch: 1 when the response carried the document, 0 when it did not (404/403, a 200 whose bytes carry no document body, or a 200 PDF with no text layer). Listing/search endpoint: the count of matching records read out of the retrieved bytes, with the counting rule in that entry's note
n_total_reported: null throughout. None of these endpoints reports a platform-wide total: the CFTC filing tables collapse to a single response under Show_All=1 and report no total, and the Federal Register API's own count is carried in n_returned for that entry
id_note: query ids ending in 'b' disambiguate two sequences numbered independently before merge. No id is reused
executed_at_note: entries carrying executed_at_basis were retrieved before the logging wrapper was in place; their timestamp is the payload-file mtime (retrieval completion), not the request-issue instant. All other entries carry the request-issue timestamp
payload_retention: raw payloads were retained outside the repository (session scratchpad, untracked) because they are large binary rule documents; the SHA-256 in payload_sha256 is the durable carrier per protocol section 5 field F12. payload_path is null throughout
